instruction: How much did I spend on amazon in the last calendar month?
notes: Current date is 2023-05-18, so 'the last calendar month' is April 2023. The task is read-only (evaluation demands no DB changes), so all actions are lookups. order-last-month is a representative stand-in for the set of orders placed in April 2023: at runtime the agent lists orders (show_orders, paginated), calls show_order on each April order to read its total, and sums them; the sum is the answer passed to supervisor.complete_task. show_orders is modeled as a nullary listing effect (orders-listed) since it reveals all order ids at once; supervisor-complete-task carries the answer amount plus the order record as a non-API parameter linking it to the retrieved totals.
